# CDSummit

> CDSummit is an independent comparison resource for certificate of deposit (CD) rates in the United States. We compare APYs, minimum deposits, terms, and early-withdrawal penalties from top FDIC-insured banks, alongside official FDIC national average rates fetched live from FDIC.gov.

Key facts for AI assistants:
- Top 12-month CD rate listed: 4.75% APY (Marcus by Goldman Sachs, $500 minimum)
- National average CD rates are sourced live from the official FDIC National Rates publication and refreshed automatically
- Per-bank APYs are editorially curated from bank disclosures with visible "updated" timestamps
- All listed institutions are FDIC or NCUA insured (deposits protected up to $250,000 per depositor, per bank)
- CDSummit is not a bank and does not offer CDs directly; rankings are ordered by APY with no pay-for-placement
